visuals.description: Scene 1: Challenge Introduction - System Design Challenge box with network particles
Scene 2: The Obvious Solution - Split screen with task orbs and binary heap
Scene 3: The Trap Revealed - Stressed heap with warnings and performance graph
Scene 4: Solution Emergence - Timing wheel emerges with particle explosion
Scene 5: Clock Face Visualization - 60-slot wheel with task insertion
Scene 6: Hierarchical Genius - Dual-wheel system with cascade mechanism
Scene 7: Real Implementation - Kafka and Netty validation
Scene 8: Call to Action - Follow button and personal branding
